prompt:
You are a equity research analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2026-04-30, give a 20-trading-day directional recommendation for the stock.
Valid answers (choose exactly one): BUY, HOLD, SELL.
Company information (as of 2026-04-30):
Price action as of 2026-04-30: 1w +3.3%, 1m +17.9%, 3m +16.7%. Last close 91.50. 21d annualized realized volatility 27%. Position in trailing 63-day range: 100% (0%=low, 100%=high).
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The stock exhibits strong positive price momentum across all short-to-medium-term horizons (+17.9% over the last month and +16.7% over three months) and has closed at its 63-day high of 91.50. This robust upward trend, coupled with moderate annualized realized volatility of 27%, suggests continued short-term capital appreciation over the next 20 trading days. 

DECISION: BUY
